_comment: Per-repo manifest for roadmap 2.30. The docs-sync agent maintains the `modules` list; docs_freshness.py reads it to compute coverage + freshness. Each module maps one doc file to the code path(s) it documents. This is DisplayNote's fork of livekit/rust-sdks (branch main): most of the tree is upstream, and the two module docs cover the areas DisplayNote maintains (see AGENTS.md, Fork delta).
